projects.name: Exorsite
projects.description:
RTS and TPS Unity game, currently in development. My role in this project has been mainly as a backend programmer. Fixing bugs, code maintenance and implementing some mechanics as well. 
You can check out the Steam page if interested.

projects.name: Arcane Spark
projects.description: Unleash your elemental fury in Arcane Spark, the ultimate competitive magic combat game! Choose from the four classical elements - Earth, Fire, Water, and Air - each with its unique strengths and weaknesses, and engage in thrilling free-for-all battles against other players.

projects.name: Catball
projects.description:
Game developed in Unity for the Global Game Jam 2022. Great personal experience and great people I met there. My role in this project was as lead programmer and the only member with experience in Unity, which at the time was quite a challenge for me. 
Click if you want to see more!
